analysis.headline: USD/KRW closes at 1,338.2 in Seoul before easing to 1,335.4 overnight
analysis.summary: USD/KRW climbed 2.5 KRW to close at 1,338.2 in Seoul daytime trading (ECB ref 1,336.21), briefly hitting 1,342.9 on tech-stock sell-offs and hawkish Fed jitters before exporter dollar sales capped gains. Overnight, softer US industrial production (-0.4%) and retreating yields pulled USD/KRW back down to 1,335.4.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW slips to 1,468.4 after EUR/USD tests 19-month lows near 1.0985
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW retreated below 1,470 to around 1,468.4 (ECB ref 1,468.36). A surging dollar initially pushed EUR/USD to a 19-month trough around 1.0985–1.0989 before improved German and Eurozone ZEW sentiment helped it steady near 1.1000. Persistent Fed-ECB rate gap concerns kept the cross under mild downward pressure.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW rises to 838.8 per 100 JPY as softer US data pulls USD/JPY to 159.3
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW climbed to around 8.39 KRW per JPY (~838.8 per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.388). A weaker -0.4% US industrial production print cooled Treasury yields and stalled the dollar's surge, pulling USD/JPY away from 160.00 toward 159.3. Despite mixed Japan GDP signals on BoJ hike timing, yen recovery lifted the cross.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW firms to 1,762.6 as sterling reclaims 1.3200 on UK jobs data
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW firmed slightly to around 1,762.6 (ECB ref 1,762.63), outperforming the euro. After dipping toward 1.3180, GBP/USD rebounded above 1.3200 as UK unemployment ticked down to 4.6% ahead of key inflation data and BoE policy cues. Combined with Seoul's firmer USD/KRW daytime close, the cross held steady gains.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW edges up to 200.4 as PBOC sets firm 6.7132 fixing
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW edged up to around 200.4 (ECB ref 200.45), reinforcing support above the key 200.0 KRW handle. Despite broad dollar strength, the PBOC set a firm USD/CNY central parity fixing at 6.7132 to curb volatility, while USD/KRW's daytime rise to 1,338.2 KRW in Seoul lifted the cross modestly into the low-200s.

AUD.headline: AUD eases to 900.0 KRW as oil plunge and risk-off outweigh hawkish RBA
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar slipped to around 900.0 KRW as sliding crude oil prices and global risk-off sentiment overshadowed hawkish RBA November minutes.

CAD.headline: CAD steadies near 935.0 KRW as higher USD/KRW offsets 3.3% WTI oil drop
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar weakened against USD as WTI crude fell 3.3% on oversupply concerns, while Seoul's firmer USD/KRW kept CAD/KRW steady near 935.0.

CHF.headline: CHF holds flat at 1,590.3 KRW as safe-haven bids balance strong dollar
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc held steady near 1,590.3 KRW as safe-haven demand during tech-led equity jitters balanced a 19-month high in the US Dollar Index.

CNY.headline: CNY edges up to 200.4 KRW on PBOC 6.7132 fixing and firmer Seoul dollar
CNY.brief: The Chinese yuan rose modestly to 200.4 KRW as the PBOC set a firm 6.7132 daily fixing against dollar strength and USD/KRW closed higher in Seoul.

EUR.headline: EUR dips to 1,468.4 KRW after testing 1.0985 lows before ZEW stabilization
EUR.brief: The euro fell to 1,468.4 KRW after EUR/USD hit 19-month lows near 1.0985, though improved German and Eurozone ZEW surveys helped steady it near 1.1000.

GBP.headline: GBP firms to 1,762.6 KRW as falling 4.6% UK jobless rate lifts cable
GBP.brief: Sterling edged up to 1,762.6 KRW as UK unemployment ticked down to 4.6%, helping GBP/USD reclaim 1.3200 ahead of inflation data and BoE signals.

HKD.headline: HKD ticks up to 170.3 KRW tracking USD's daytime climb in Seoul
HKD.brief: Anchored by its USD currency peg near 7.846, the Hong Kong dollar edged up to 170.3 KRW in line with USD/KRW's daytime rise to 1,338.2.

JPY.headline: JPY climbs to 838.8 per 100 JPY as soft US output pulls USD/JPY to 159.3
JPY.brief: The yen gained to 838.8 KRW per 100 JPY as a -0.4% US industrial production print cooled yields and pulled USD/JPY back from 160 toward 159.3.

KRW.headline: KRW recovers to 1,335.4 overnight after 1,342.9 intraday low on Fed fears
KRW.brief: The won closed Seoul daytime trading down 2.5 KRW at 1,338.2 after touching 1,342.9, then recovered to 1,335.4 overnight on soft US output and exporter sales.

USD.headline: USD climbs to 1,338.2 in Seoul before easing to 1,335.4 on soft output
USD.brief: The US dollar surged past 103.7 DXY to close at 1,338.2 KRW in Seoul before softer -0.4% US industrial output pulled it back to 1,335.4 overnight.
